This pKa data was from the DataWarrior application (http://www.openmolecules.org/). A file named "pKaInWater.dwar" containing the pKa data is included in the DataWarrior download and contains experimentally-measured pKa values in water for 7912 chemicals along with SMILES strings. The providers of the original file collected and compiled pKa values representing different protonation states. Unfortunately, there are no literature references to support the pKa values. Most of these values are given as an average of multiple experimental values.
